description: MainActivity.kt defines the main UI controller for an Android Tic Tac Toe application, managing game state, user interactions, and screen updates.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class handling the Tic Tac Toe game UI and interaction logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up click listeners for game cells and reset button, and restores game state if available.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current game state into the bundle to preserve across configuration changes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates UI components to reflect the current game state, including board cells, status, and end-game messages.

methods.name: showResultSnackbar
methods.description: Displays a Snackbar message indicating game result, with an action to reset the game.
